events.title: 아스널 suffer a shock 4–2 league home defeat to 찰턴 애슬레틱.
Out of favour striker Paul Kitson scores a hat-trick for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in a 4–4 draw at 찰턴 애슬레틱 in the Premier League.
입스위치 타운 , bottom of the Premier League after finishing fifth last season, pay 블랙번 로버스 £3 million for striker Marcus Bent .
맨체스터 유나이티드's dismal run of form continues with a 3–1 defeat at 아스널.

바이에른 뮌헨 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan for the second time, by defeating titleholder 보카 주니어스 from Argentina : 1–0. The only goal for the Germans is scored by Ghanaian defender Sammy Kuffour .
Robbie Fowler ends a decade at 리버풀 in an £11 million move to 리즈 유나이티드.

리버풀 are the month-end Premier League leaders, with 리즈 유나이티드, 아스널, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라 completing the top five. 맨체스터 유나이티드, however, occupy a disappointing sixth place – the result of a series of dismal performances in recent weeks. 입스위치 타운, who finished fifth in the league last season, are now bottom of the table with just one win so far, while 레스터 시티 and 더비 카운티 remain in the drop zone – but only level on goal difference with 사우샘프턴. 번리 are the new leaders of Division One, having leapfrogged 울버햄프턴 원더러스 into second place. 노리치 시티, 프레스턴 노스 엔드, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 크리스털 팰리스 complete the top six.
